page.layout: One page of running text, in a single column. Running head at top left with page number at top right. No marginal notes. Scripture references are set as separate short lines within the text. Signature at bottom left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: men[?] radijs solis paulo post discutiuntur ita carnis intelligentia nonnunquam caliginem infert menti, quae tamen fidei lu-cem Sole iusticiae Christo Domino no-stro mentibus piis inferente, discutitur.
main_text.head: ȝ[?]. De fiducia exauditionis precum.
main_text.p: Cum fides sit πληροφορία[?] de veracitate, omnipotentia, omniscientia & misericordia Dei, non relinquit fidelem, in Spiritu & veritate orante, animi dubium de exauditione.Repetit enim dulcissimas pro missiones de exauditione precum, e quarum numero hae sunt.
Psal.50.15. Invoca me in die tribulationis, & eruam te, & glorificabis me.
Psal.91.15. Invocat me, itaq; respondebo ei: cum ipso sum in tribulatione.
Matt.7.11. Si vos igitur, cum sitis mali, noftis dona bona dare liberis vestris, quanto magis Pater vester qui est in coe-lis, dabit bona iis qui ab ipso petent?
Matt.21.22. Et quaecunq; precando petieritis, si credideritis, accipietis.
Iac.5.16. Multum valet deprecatio iusti efficax.

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed. The first line is damaged; "men[?]" and "radijs" are uncertain. The section marker before the heading is uncertain and marked [?]. The Scripture references are in the text, not in the margin, so they are running text. Printed spelling "noftis", "dulcissimas" and "deprecatio" kept as printed.
